features.title: init.sh lock / unlock — take and release the session lock in one command that refuses when held
features.user_visible_behavior: none (agent process): `docs/harness/init.sh lock <item>` and `init.sh unlock` replace hand-written session.lock files

verification.step: `init.sh lock <item>` on a free lock: writes the canonical format (session/agent/started/item), commits, pushes, prints the session id + the export HARNESS_SESSION line; exit 0

`init.sh lock` with a failing push leaves the local commit and reports it (README "Failed state push"); never forces
`init.sh unlock` only by the owner (HARNESS_SESSION matches the REMOTE lock); deletes, commits, pushes; refuses otherwise (exit 2)
